claims.statement: The GPSR became applicable on 13 December 2024 and strengthens online-sales duties, including an EU responsible person for relevant products coming from outside the EU.
Safety Gate is the official rapid-alert system for dangerous non-food products and supports post-listing monitoring and action.

contrary_evidence: Major marketplaces enforce listing fields natively, responsible-person firms bundle documentation, and sellers with few SKUs can manage records manually.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: cross-market product identity, listing-rejection correction and recall-match graph
fingerprint.customer: EU importers, responsible persons and marketplace sellers managing many non-food consumer SKUs
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: marketplace listing agencies and feed-management platforms
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: verified evidence record, marketplace feed adapter and alert-to-takedown workflow

founder_fit: Data-entity-resolution and automation fit with agency-led distribution and no personal brand. UNVALIDATED HYPOTHESIS: PLN 60000 funds a two-marketplace, one-category pilot.
risks: False product matching can wrongly suppress a listing.
Unverified supplier documents create liability and counterfeit risk.

structure.control_point: SKU listing-feed approval and recall-takedown command
structure.critical_dependency: verified manufacturer and responsible-person records plus marketplace feed permissions

thesis: Maintain a verified evidence record for each non-food consumer SKU and syndicate manufacturer, EU responsible-person, warning and safety fields into marketplace feeds, then trigger takedowns when a matching Safety Gate signal appears. Multi-market feed corrections and recall matches compound into a product-identity graph that listing agencies cannot reproduce from static templates.
title: GPSR Listing-Evidence Syndicator
uncertainties: Marketplace API access and field consistency
Merchant willingness to pay per SKU
Ability to verify overseas manufacturer evidence remotely
